newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Brandrill to raise A$8.2 million.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Brandrill to raise A$8.2 million.

text.p: Contract miner Brandrill Ltd said on Friday it would raise A$8.2 million through a placement of shares and a one-for-four rights issue.
The company said a placement of 4.1 million shares, about 10 percent of the company's capital, at a price of 57 cents per share would raise about A$2.3 million.
The one-for-four rights issue at an issue price of 53 cents per share would raise about A$5.9 million.
The issues have been fully underwritten by Bain and Co Corporate Finance with Morgan Stockbroking acting as co-manager to the rights issue.

Brandrill said the issues would prepare the company for further growth. "This capital raising will position Brandrill to continue its business expansion as well as reduce the company's exposure to operational cash flow risks," managing director Jeff Branson said in a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange.
By 10.35 a.m. (2335 GMT), Brandrill shares were steady at 65 cents on turnover of 55,000 shares.
